messages:
Ibrahim Noor: Quick idea - add a compact per-route workbench mini that shows: active model, quota bar, recent cost delta, and a tiny 'swap' action. keep it non-modal.

Sofia Lee: +1. initial render should call a cheap brief: GET /api/console/route_brief?route=rt-77 which returns {current_model,is_canary,quota_pct}. no time-series.

Jonas Beck: on interaction (open or preview) fetch /api/console/route_detail?route=rt-77&window=1h for sparkline and cost preview. detail fetch must be rate-limited/cached.

Ibrahim Noor: UX: when user selects a saved query from tile, run POST /api/console/apply_view {view_id,scope: 'route'} and show cost_delta_pct before applying. include tooltip explaining sample window.

Sofia Lee: backend note: if view references a model not available in region, return compatible_alternatives with short reason tags and cost_preview. UI shows a 'show compatible' dropdown.

Jonas Beck: permissioning: if user lacks route.override show disabled override with 'request' link. log actions as console.workbench.action events with minimal payload.

qa-bot: [SYSTEM] perf-check: simulated 200 tiles opening -> brief endpoint cache TTL 15s required to keep QPS sane.

Ibrahim Noor: feature flag: feat/mini-workbench. rollout alpha internal -> 5% opt-in -> GA. Owners: Sofia api, Jonas telemetry/logs, Ibrahim PRD.

Sofia Lee: I'll draft the API schema and add X-Console-API version header. short docs next.

Jonas Beck: will add trace deep-link format: /trace?route=rt-77&variant=v3&seed=xyz. keep payload tiny.

Ibrahim Noor: cool. thanks, will collate mocks and checklist in the PRD.
